title: Particular provisions prevail.
bodyText: If any provision of this code as incorporated in this article by section 431:20-103 is in conflict with any provision of this article, the provision contained in this article shall prevail.
bodyHtml: §431:20-104  Particular provisions prevail.  If any provision of this code as incorporated in this article by section 431:20-103 is in conflict with any provision of this article, the provision contained in this article shall prevail. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
